q: According to Anthropic’s own announcement, what had Anthropic done toward an initial public offering?
options: Listed its common stock on a public exchange
Confidentially submitted a draft Form S-1 to the SEC for a proposed IPO
Published a public prospectus with a price range
Announced that it had decided not to go public
explain: The announcement says Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft registration statement on Form S-1 for a proposed initial public offering, which gives it the option to go public after the SEC completes its review. A draft submission is not a listing.

evidence.quote: confidentially submitted a draft registration statement on Form S-1 to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of our common stock

q: How does Anthropic describe Project Glasswing in its June 2026 expansion post?
options: A collaborative effort to secure the world’s most important software
A purpose-built military defense model sold to large technology companies
An early-access chatbot program limited to big tech companies
A bug bounty paid to outside researchers
explain: The post calls Glasswing a collaborative effort to secure the world’s most important software, built around access to Claude Mythos Preview, and extended it to approximately 150 new organizations in industries such as power, water, healthcare, communications and hardware.

evidence.quote: The group covers several industries that weren’t well represented in our initial cohort, such as power, water, healthcare, communications, and hardware.
we announced that roughly 50 initial partners had access to Claude Mythos Preview
Project Glasswing is our collaborative effort to secure the world’s most important software.
we’re extending the partnership to approximately 150 new organizations. Each one will need to meet our security requirements before they gain access.

q: How does Anthropic relate Claude Fable 5 to Claude Mythos 5 in its 9 June 2026 post?
options: Mythos 5 is a smaller, cheaper model distilled from Fable 5
Mythos 5 and Fable 5 are two names for the same model with identical safeguards
Mythos 5 is the same underlying model as Fable 5, with safeguards lifted in some areas
Fable 5 is an older model that Mythos 5 replaces
explain: The post says Mythos 5 is the same underlying model as Fable 5, with safeguards lifted in some areas, and prices both at $10 and $50 per million input and output tokens. So they are not two models of different size, and they do not carry identical safeguards.

evidence.quote: It’s the same underlying model as Fable 5, but with the safeguards lifted in some areas.
Fable 5 and Mythos 5 are being offered at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens—less than half the price of Claude Mythos Preview.
Today’s joint launch is another step towards our goal of bringing advanced AI capabilities to as many users as possible

q: What did Anthropic raise in its Series H, announced on 28 May 2026?
options: $65 billion at a $965 billion post-money valuation
$13 billion at a $183 billion post-money valuation
$30 billion at a $380 billion post-money valuation
$3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation
explain: The Series H post says Anthropic raised $65 billion at $965 billion post-money. The other options are the amounts in the Series G, Series F and 2025 funding posts.

evidence.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.
We have raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue, valuing Anthropic at $380 billion post-money.
Anthropic has completed a Series F fundraising of $13 billion led by ICONIQ. This financing values Anthropic at $183 billion post-money.
Anthropic has raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation.

q: Which AI Safety Level protections did Anthropic activate in conjunction with launching Claude Opus 4 in May 2025?
explain: The post says Anthropic activated the ASL-3 Deployment and Security Standards in conjunction with launching Claude Opus 4. The 2023 Responsible Scaling Policy post said current LLMs appeared to be ASL-2.

evidence.quote: We have activated the AI Safety Level 3 (ASL-3) Deployment and Security Standards described in Anthropic’s Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP) in conjunction with launching Claude Opus 4.
Our RSP defines a framework called AI Safety Levels (ASL) for addressing catastrophic risks, modeled loosely after the US government’s biosafety level (BSL) standards
Current LLMs, including Claude, appear to be ASL-2.

q: In its February 2026 report on distillation, how many exchanges with Claude did the three named labs generate through about 24,000 fraudulent accounts?
explain: The report says DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax generated over 16 million exchanges with Claude through approximately 24,000 fraudulent accounts.

evidence.quote: We have identified industrial-scale campaigns by three AI laboratories—DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax—to illicitly extract Claude’s capabilities to improve their own models.
These labs generated over 16 million exchanges with Claude through approximately 24,000 fraudulent accounts, in violation of our terms of service and regional access restrictions.
